source: 上外版必修第二册 Unit 2 Grammar in Use:关系副词 when/where/why = 介词+which。句子地道、Animals 主题、答案唯一(从句缺状语才用关系副词,缺主/宾用 which/that)。

points.point: where(地点先行词,从句缺地点状语)
points.overview: 先行词表地点(zoo/park/island/place/habitat 等)、从句不缺主宾(只缺地点状语)时,用关系副词 where(= in/at/on which)。若从句缺主语或宾语则用 which/that,不用 where。

points.point: when(时间先行词,从句缺时间状语)
points.overview: 先行词表时间(day/season/moment/year/time 等)、从句完整(只缺时间状语)时,用关系副词 when(= on/in/during which)。若从句缺主宾则用 which/that。

points.point: why(原因 reason)+ 介词+which 替代 where/when
points.overview: 先行词为 reason、从句缺原因状语时用 why(= for which);正式或介词提前时用「介词+which」(the day on which / the place in which / a means by which);介词后只能用 which,不可用 that/where/when。

questions.stem: "This is the zoo ____ I first saw a real giant panda."
questions.explanation: 先行词 zoo 表地点、从句完整(只缺地点状语)→ where。

questions.explanation: 先行词 period 表时间、从句完整 → when。

questions.stem: "The reason ____ many zoos exist is to protect endangered species."

questions.stem: "I finally understood the reason ____ the penguin kept coming back."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: "One reason ____ zoos matter is the funding they give to conservation."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "That is the main reason ____ the rare frogs are kept indoors."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "Keeping their brains in order is not the only reason ____ animals sleep."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason → why。

questions.stem: "There must be a reason ____ so many tourists travel to see Australian wildlife."

questions.stem: "These were the bones and shells on ____ the first marks were carved."
questions.explanation: 介词 on 后只能用 which(不可 that/where)。

questions.stem: "The dry season is the time during ____ animals gather around rivers."
questions.explanation: 介词 during 后用 which(= the time when)。

questions.stem: "This is the small boat in ____ he carried the penguin to the island."
questions.explanation: 介词 in 后指物用 which。

questions.stem: "That is the gentle way in ____ a young tiger should be trained."
questions.explanation: the way in which;介词 in 后用 which。

questions.stem: "Caring for a pet is a means by ____ children learn to be responsible."
questions.explanation: a means by which;介词 by 后用 which。

questions.stem: "The zoo is the place at ____ the wounded eagle slowly recovered."
questions.explanation: 介词 at 后用 which(= the place where)。

questions.stem: "11 September 2001 was the day on ____ Salty saved his blind owner."
questions.explanation: the day on which;介词 on 后用 which(= the day when)。

questions.stem: "The brush with ____ the cat was gently washed was very soft."
questions.explanation: 介词 with 后指物用 which。

questions.stem: "That is the island to ____ the penguin was first taken by boat."
questions.explanation: 介词 to 后指物用 which。

questions.stem: "Hibernation is the way in ____ some animals survive the cold winter."
questions.explanation: the way in which;介词 in 后用 which。

questions.stem: "The reason ____ the koala stays in Australia is its special diet."
questions.explanation: 先行词 reason、缺原因状语 → why。

questions.stem: "That is the tank in ____ the tropical fish are kept warm all year."
questions.explanation: the tank in which;介词 in 后用 which(= the tank where)。
